title: Ethiopian Café Sandwich
author: Chef Haile
desc: Ethiopian Café Sandwich — roasted chicken or berbere beef in toasted bread with berbere mayo, ayib, silsi, shredded cabbage, and jalapeños. The Ethiopian café's signature lunch sandwich — completely Ethiopian in flavour despite the globally familiar format.
longDesc: The Ethiopian café sandwich is the modern urban lunch — the bread, the mayonnaise, and the sandwich format are international; the berbere mayo, the ayib, and the silsi make it unmistakably Ethiopian.
ingredients: 200g roasted chicken or berbere beef slices
equipment: Toaster or grill pan for bread
steps: Spread berbere mayo on both cut faces.
Layer cabbage, chicken or beef, tomato, jalapeños.
chefTips: Toast the bread — warmth activates the berbere mayo.
Ayib inside the sandwich is the Ethiopian upgrade to cheese.
cookingScience: Heat from toasted bread melts the ayib slightly and activates the volatile aromatics in the berbere mayo.
culturalNote: The Ethiopian café sandwich is the lunch of Addis Ababa's professional class — the sandwich eaten at the desk, at the café counter, and in the car between meetings. Its Ethiopianness is expressed not in form but in flavour.
